brand.name: Trainlytix
brand.tone: Professional, focused, authoritative yet approachable, organized

components.sidebar: Fixed left, dark mode (bg-slate-900). Active item has light background (bg-slate-800) and left accent border (border-l-4 border-blue-500).
components.header: Sticky top, white background, bottom border (border-b border-slate-200), glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80).
components.status_pill: Rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium border.
components.progress_bar: h-2 w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden, filled portion bg-blue-600.
components.charts: Shadcn charts (Recharts). Line chart for performance trend, Radial bar for Attendance.

interactions.hover: Subtle translate-y or shadow change on cards. Button hover darkens background. Explicit hover states on all interactables.
interactions.animation: Framer motion for page transitions and staggering list items.

login.layout: Split screen. Left side: Abstract generated corporate image. Right side: Login form card.
login.components: Shadcn Form, Input, Button. Custom branding.

widgets: Upcoming Sessions (col-span-1 row-span-2): List of items.
Pending Assignments (col-span-2): Table or List with status pills.
Recent Materials (col-span-full): Card grid of thumbnails.

image_urls.description: Abstract corporate 3D geometric shapes for login screen split view.
Professional smiling headshot for header profile.
3D isometric abstract composition for courses/learning materials.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up Tailwind CSS configuration with the defined color palette and typography.
Implement the Layout component with a sticky header and a dark sidebar (collapsible on mobile).
Use Shadcn UI components extensively (Card, Button, Badge, Input, Form, Avatar, DropdownMenu).
Do not use generic 'Inter' font. Apply the provided font families.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all interactive elements for testing purposes.
Create a clean Split-Screen login page with the provided generated image as the left background.
For the Dashboard grid, utilize the 'Control Room' grid pattern with tight gaps (gap-6) and use col-span/row-span effectively to prevent jagged edges.
